visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female dermatologist with short brown hair and round glasses is the primary subject. She wears a beige ribbed knit sweater and a small black microphone is clipped to her collar. She speaks directly to the camera with a bright, professional smile, gesturing with her hands. The setting is a modern medical office with vertical wooden slat walls and framed certificates. (2) A sharp visual cut introduces close-up images of skin affected by severe, inflamed acne. The shot size alternates between full-face views and macro close-ups of specific lesion clusters. Transitioning back, the speaker points toward on-screen text overlays while maintaining an animated expression. (3) The background shifts briefly to graphic animations of skin cells and product ingredient lists in white text boxes. The speaker remains in the frame, her head and shoulders visible, nodding to emphasize her medical advice. (4) A final sequence displays 'Before and After' comparisons side-by-side, showing clear skin improvement. The lighting is bright and studio-grade, casting a clean, professional glow. The video ends on a static white screen containing clinic contact details, logos, and QR codes.

(3) A series of 'pop' and 'click' sound effects occur rapidly, synchronized with the visual appearance of ingredient lists. The BGM maintains a consistent loop.
